scope: Fiscal sponsorship education and nonprofit financial administration guidance

records.name: Fiscal Sponsorship for Nonprofits
records.description: National Council of Nonprofits guidance explaining how fiscal sponsorship works, what fiscal sponsors may provide, why organizations use the arrangement, common administrative fees, sponsor control requirements, written-agreement considerations, and links to additional resources.
records.availability_notes: This is an educational resource, not a fiscal sponsor directory or sponsorship offer. Fiscal sponsors may charge administrative fees and must retain legal control and discretion over contributed funds. Users should review any arrangement with qualified legal, tax, and accounting professionals.
